title: Debugger Evaluator: Evaluate button starts clickable (not greyed out) even when expression field is empty
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 63.75 GiB memory ### Issue description In the Debugger > Evaluator panel, the Evaluate button starts clickable = not greyed out when you show the panel for the first time during a given breakpoint hit, although the expression field may be empty. Clicking on it would do nothing. Typing some expression and delete it will force refresh and grey out the button. Submitting an expression to Evaluate via Enter or by clicking Evaluate button with some expression written will also force refresh and make it greyed out. **More context** I like the new Evaluator for quick expression evaluation, but it is quite confusing to use as a watcher. After evaluating a few expressions, I understood that those expressions were not updated on next breakpoint hit. At first I thought the Evaluate button was meant to refresh their values, but clicking it did nothing. Then I realised that clicking Evaluate button was actually the same as pressing Enter after entering an expression in the expression field, and that it was a bug that caused it not to be greyed out. As a matter of fact, to refresh a value you need to type it again and Evaluate it again, which is not very useful since at that point the history will show the same value again anyway. But that's another issue. In fact, I will probably open more issues and proposals about readability, automatic and active value refresh. ### Steps to reproduce - Create dummy script with a breakpoint in `_ready: pass` - Run game in the editor - Break - Open Debugger > Evaluator - Check the Evaluate button ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
